scenes.text: Imagine driving through a quiet desert when suddenly, your radio goes completely silent, your compass spins out of control, and your phone dies.
You’ve just entered the Zone of Silence in Mexico, a bizarre patch of land where electromagnetic signals simply vanish into thin air.
Meteorites are strangely attracted to this specific patch of dirt, striking it far more than any other place nearby.
Would you dare to spend a night camping in this magnetic dead zone?
